title: Handling list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location"

entities.name: PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location list
entities.description: A list stored by the UE containing PLMNs that are not allowed to operate at the current UE location when accessing via satellite E-UTRAN. Each entry contains PLMN identity, geographical location (if known), and an implementation-specific distance value.

entities.name: EMM cause #78
entities.description: EMM cause value #78 indicating 'PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location'. This cause is applicable only when the UE is accessing a PLMN using satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: PLMN access restriction condition
entities.description: Conditions under which the UE shall not attempt to access a PLMN via satellite E-UTRAN if it is in the not-allowed list, including distance checks, timer expiration, or emergency services access.

entities.name: Timer for PLMN list entry
entities.description: Implementation-specific timer associated with each entry in the PLMN not-allowed list. Started when a new entry is stored and used to determine when access restrictions can be lifted.

entities.name: Satellite E-UTRAN access
entities.description: Access technology condition specifying that the PLMN list handling procedures apply specifically when the UE is accessing via satellite E-UTRAN.

entities.name: Emergency services access exception
entities.description: Condition that allows UE to access a PLMN in the not-allowed list if the access is for emergency services.

relations.description: Receipt of EMM cause #78 via satellite E-UTRAN triggers the creation of an entry in the PLMN not-allowed list.
When a new entry is stored in the PLMN not-allowed list, the UE starts a timer instance associated with that entry.
The PLMN access restriction condition guards access attempts to PLMNs in the not-allowed list based on distance, timer status, and emergency services.
Timer expiration is one of the conditions that lifts the PLMN access restriction.
Emergency services access is an exception that overrides the PLMN access restriction.
The PLMN not-allowed list handling procedures are only applicable when the UE is accessing via satellite E-UTRAN technology.
